name: Leggings
description: Skin-tight stretch leggings that hold warmth against the legs and leave no room for pockets.
notes: Folded in three layers, 220 mm by 200 mm and 24 mm tall, black lycra with a charcoal elastic waistband. Slot `legs`: Deadvox has no under-trouser layer, so leggings take the trouser slot until one exists. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rag loincloth
description: A flap of mismatched cotton scraps hung from a tie cord. It covers the bare minimum.
notes: Laid flat: a 180 mm by 300 mm rag flap with two sewn-on patches and a ragged hem, the cotton tie cord trailing down both sides. Slot `legs`: Deadvox has no underwear slot, so it takes the trouser slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur loincloth
description: A whole small pelt, leg tabs and tail still on, tied around the waist with a rawhide thong.
notes: Laid flat: a 200 mm by 300 mm brown pelt with its four leg tabs, tail and a pale belly stripe, its rawhide thong trailing down both sides. A pelt lies flat over a wide area. Slot `legs`: Deadvox has no underwear slot, so it takes the trouser slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather loincloth
description: Square leather patches stitched into a flap and hung from a leather thong.
notes: Laid flat: a 200 mm by 300 mm flap of four leather squares joined by cross stitching, on a tan leather thong trailing down both sides. Slot `legs`: Deadvox has no underwear slot, so it takes the trouser slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wool loincloth
description: Scraps of knitted wool sewn into a flap and hung from a cord.
notes: Laid flat: a 170 mm by 280 mm grey wool flap with two felt patches and a ragged hem, on a cotton cord trailing down both sides. Slot `legs`: Deadvox has no underwear slot, so it takes the trouser slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Nanoskirt
description: A denim skirt so short it barely counts as one.
notes: Laid flat: a flared denim skirt 360 mm across the hem and 140 mm long, with a waistband, button, fly seam, side seams and pale hem stitching. Slot `legs`, as skirts have no slot of their own. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Khaki trousers
description: Plain khaki cotton trousers, a little warmer than jeans.
notes: Folded in four layers, 260 mm by 340 mm and 56 mm tall: waistband with belt loops and a brass button at the back edge, centre seam, and one back pocket on top. Pockets as the jeans have them. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Army trousers
description: Tough olive field trousers with flapped back pockets and bellows cargo pockets on both thighs.
notes: Folded in four layers, 270 mm by 340 mm and 64 mm tall: waistband with belt loops, a flapped back pocket and a cargo pocket with flap and press stud on top. Box/volume x3.1: the cargo pocket stands proud of the stack. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Checkered trousers
description: Cotton trousers in a small grey and charcoal check.
notes: Folded in three layers, 260 mm by 320 mm and 40 mm tall. No plaid print exists, so a small grid of raised 16 mm `cloth-heather-grey` squares over `cloth-charcoal` stands in for it, small and soft enough not to read as a chessboard. A folded stack has air between its layers. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Faux fur trousers
description: Long cotton trousers lined with thick synthetic fur.
notes: Folded thick in four layers, 280 mm by 360 mm and 90 mm tall: charcoal cotton with pale synthetic fur showing at the waist and along both folded sides; belt loops, a button and a back pocket. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur trousers
description: Heavy trousers lined with real fur and drawn shut at the waist with a cord.
notes: Folded thick in four layers, 280 mm by 360 mm and 90 mm tall: brown cotton with brown fur showing at the waist and both folded sides, a rawhide drawcord instead of belt loops. Two front pockets only. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hiking trousers
description: Light, water-resistant nylon trousers that flex with the stride, with plenty of pockets.
notes: Folded in four layers, 250 mm by 330 mm and 50 mm tall, grey-green nylon: belt loops, a flapped back pocket, a slim flapped cargo pocket and the zip line where the lower leg comes off. Box/volume x3.4: the stack is light cloth with air between its layers. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather trousers
description: Heavy black leather trousers. Very tough, but stiff, with only two shallow pockets.
notes: Folded in three layers, 270 mm by 340 mm and 60 mm tall: belt loops, a steel button and a charcoal centre seam; no pocket shows on top. The leather resists scrapes and cuts, so it gets light protection. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Ski trousers
description: Insulated trousers for alpine skiing, with an elastic waist and padded knees.
notes: Folded in three layers, 270 mm by 340 mm and 60 mm tall, navy with black padded knee panels and a drawcord waist. Navy cloth stands in for the insulated shell, which folds bulky. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Tactical trousers
description: Rugged, water-repellent combat trousers with double-stitched seams, reinforced belt loops, articulated knees and pockets everywhere.
notes: Folded in four layers, 270 mm by 340 mm and 64 mm tall, coyote nylon: black webbing belt loops, a flapped back pocket, a cargo pocket with flap and press stud, and an articulated knee panel with darts. Box/volume x3.1: the cargo pocket stands proud of the stack. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
